entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Arnold Graffi was a pioneering German doctor in the area of experimental cancer research. He was the first to identify viruses that induce tumours. He also studied chemical carcinogens. Along with Heinz Bielka he wrote an influential textbook on cancer research titled Probleme der Experimentellen Krebsforschung (1959).
